2. Claim 5 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of a blocking vaccine __comprising a Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction from Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes and saponin, wherein the vaccine is administered to a canine subject to impede transmission of Leishmaniasis to humans__.

3. Claim 6 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of a reagent __comprising a Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction from Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes and saponin, further comprising suitable pharmacological vehicles, for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission in canine animals__.

4. Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates at 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of mannose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, aminoacids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine.
